_comment: EQUIPA MCP server hardening (task 2452): privileged tool calls (equipa_dispatch, equipa_task_create) require EQUIPA_MCP_TOKEN. EQUIPA_MCP_COST_CAP_USD bounds 24h dispatch spend. EQUIPA_MCP_PROJECT_IDS optionally restricts task_create targets to a comma-separated allowlist.
_comment_paths: Agents run in the project directory and MCP servers inherit it (tasks 3120/3127). Dispatch is refused unless every stdio server is on the launch allowlist (task 3134, IR-03): an absolute python with -I running an absolute script (or -I -m with an absolute cwd), an absolute node running an absolute script with no -r/--require/--import/--loader/-e/-p, an absolute uvx running a package, or a server executable whose absolute path is listed under "mcp_trusted_executables" in dispatch_config.json (task 3138, RR-02; any other program is refused). The command must exist. A python, node or uvx command must be the real program (task 3144, RR3138-C): the same file as the one installed under that name in /usr/local/bin, /usr/bin or /bin (a symlink to it is fine), the orchestrator's own python, or a path listed under "mcp_trusted_executables"; uv installs uvx in ~/.local/bin, so list that path there. Residual risk: a binary's content is not verified, so a listed path is only as safe as its directory; agents share the operator UID and can write the operator HOME (~/.local/bin) until agent isolation gives them their own UID. Wrappers (timeout, nice, env, setarch, prlimit, systemd-run, sg, su, sudo, ld.so ...), shells (also a renamed copy of one), uv/poetry/pipx/npx/deno/go/make and other runtimes are refused even when listed, as are uvx --with-editable and uvx --from/--with/-w naming a relative path, a file: URL or a project directory. uvx's own options (before the tool name) are read with uvx's option table, and an option it does not list is refused: each index, find-links, constraint, requirement or directory value (--index, --default-index, --index-url/-i, --extra-index-url, --find-links/-f, --constraints/-c, --build-constraints/-b, --overrides, --with-requirements, --directory, --project, --config-file ..., short, long, attached and = forms alike) must be an absolute path outside every project directory or an https URL listed under "mcp_uvx_trusted_urls" in dispatch_config.json (task 3144, RR3138-B; a bare name such as -f wheels is relative to the project directory). NODE_OPTIONS, PYTHONPATH, PYTHONSTARTUP, LD_* and UV_* in a server env are refused, as is any path argument (also --opt=path) inside a project directory. --db-path must be ABSOLUTE. Replace every /path/to placeholder.
